cohort.rootReportedCampaign: 93 product sets and41736 rows completed; BCL later stopped on a separately investigated harness exception. This review supplies no new execution evidence.

constraints: No original schema, instance, metadata, expectation, applicability, or recorded result was changed.
No product builds, tests, counters, measurements, reference runners or new workers were executed by this review.
Data extraction and SHA256 identity verification are source inspection, not product execution.
No blanket exclusion, no automatic ResourceCycle-to-invalid translation, no Denied/null-to-Unavailable conversion, and no gate pass is authorized.
Any later repair, exact mapping, derived profile or gate disposition requires its appropriate owning assessment/authorization and separate actual evidence.
Stored observations are selected identity/outcome summaries; full raw journal rows and input bytes are not archived. Raw row hashes retain provenance.

categories.rationale: Both original INVALID schemas currently compile as schema-valid. The principal document references namespace b without importing it; an included chameleon document imports b. Compiler Imported recursively walks Source.Includes and improperly authorizes the principal QName from the included document import. Original metadata is stable with W3C issue4057.
categories.nextAction: Own a narrow compiler repair and independent original/three-direction regression tests; preserve per-document namespace permissions independently of the global component table.

categories.rationale: All four groups explicitly target XSD1.0 and are accepted. Eager rejection of a missing type, substitution head, or list item type prevents assessment of unaffected good elements. Second Edition5.3 allows absent component references with consequences when needed during assessment. The frozen reject-invalid-schema publication rule does not itself make every missing component an invalid schema. Group1 has a copied schema-test name missing001.xsd but actually supplies missing002.xsd; its bad-element instance expectation is VALID despite misleading prose.
categories.nextAction: Compiler/model/evaluator owner must assess faithful missing-component representation and validation. Prove all four original schema/instance triples, including the distinct group1 valid missing-head case. No unresolved required type may silently become anyType; no1.1 exclusion or blanket frozen-interface waiver.

categories.rationale: These originals use XSD1.1-only notQName/notNamespace/defined-name wildcard features. Metadata lacks a version gate, so the faithful metadata importer classified them applicable. Product unknown-attribute rejection is consistent with the frozen1.0 profile.
categories.nextAction: Prepare exact source-pinned applicability corrections with metadata/source rationale. Do not exclude IBM generally, rewrite original expectations, or count current nonpasses as passes. This triage grants no exclusion.

categories.rationale: Metadata explicitly includes1.0 and1.1. vc001/vc002/vc014/vc024 depend on XSD1.1 conditional-inclusion attributes minVersion/maxVersion/typeAvailable/typeUnavailable/facetAvailable to remove otherwise incompatible constructs. The raw frozen SecondEdition path does not perform that preprocessing.
categories.nextAction: Decide an exact preprocessing profile or separately authorized adapter. Preserve original bytes and observed failures; no blanket VC exclusion or implicit1.1 runtime expansion.

categories.rationale: Each original expected validity is indeterminate, so no binary valid/invalid comparison is available. Eleven actual records have passed:null; particlesZ026.v is schema-unavailable and schZ012_a is incomplete-refusal, both recorded passed:false. Completion/refusal is distinct from an original validity oracle.
categories.nextAction: Retain all exact original indeterminate values and actual observations. Assess reporting/gate treatment explicitly; award no original pass credit and do not infer schema/instance invalidity from a refusal.

categories.rationale: Resolver journals record denied-unmapped-absence for authored locations outside the current exact VerifiedOptionalMissing allowlist. These uses are include/import or annotation-only/empty redefine. They are not missing pinned catalog files. Existing product Denied handling is correct for the adapter response.
categories.nextAction: Candidate mappings must bind exact case/principal/referrer hashes, original SystemId and resolved URI plus ordinal catalog absence. Keep case variants such as Schz012_b.xsd and Schz012_C.xsd distinct. No global null-to-Unavailable fallback or case-fold redirect. Then authorize bounded original reruns; this file predicts no passing outcome, including the expected-invalid URI case.

categories.rationale: mgO020/mgP041/mgP050 contain nonempty redefine referring to absent foo. Unlike optional composition, replacement components require successful resolution. Resource refusal also prevents reaching additional invalid all-group occurrence constraints.
categories.nextAction: Keep schema assessment incomplete. Resolve specific semantic-error/resource-policy or exact gate treatment; never map these mandatory references to optional compile success.

categories.rationale: Four IBM originals involve redefine cycles, not merely ordinary includes; their original oracle and schZ006 are INVALID, but current terminal is incomplete ResourceCycle refusal. schU1 expects VALID while metadata remains disputed-test and W3C4135 unresolved. Existing approvals for schU3/U4/U5 do not cover these six.
categories.nextAction: Establish exact illegal-redefinition semantics or request exact gate dispositions. Do not translate every ResourceCycle into schema-invalid; schU1 requires its own disputed-source assessment.

categories.rationale: These instance-only originals hint invalid schemas. test73456.xsd places attribute inside sequence; test84002_a/b.xsd contain forbidden prefixed namespace undeclarations; addB191a.xsd references no-namespace b without its own import. Current schema-unavailable does not assess the original instance predicate.
categories.nextAction: Preserve original instance INVALID expectations and unassessed observations. Require exact prerequisite/profile or human gate treatment; do not drop/modify hinted schemas or relabel compile rejection as instance-invalid.

categories.rationale: stE110.xsd has union cycle st to st2 to st. The original schema expects VALID despite the1.0 circular-union prohibition and queried upstream issue4957. Product rejects the schema; its dependent instance is unassessed.
categories.nextAction: Prepare exact source-derived INVALID rationale and seek required authorization; preserve the original schema nonpass and dependent unassessed result.

categories.rationale: Metadata describes particlesZ001 restriction as invalid in1.0 and valid in1.1, but schema VALID is not version-gated. The1.0 restriction mapping fails its occurrence comparison; dependent1.0 instance INVALID cannot be assessed after compile failure.
categories.nextAction: Prepare exact source-derived INVALID profile and required authorization; retain original schema failure and unassessed instance. No new runtime defect established.

categories.rationale: addB163.v repeats the same foo hint after a prior physical foo namespace use. Original expects VALID. Actual remains instance-hint-ordering-limitation; its recorded supplementary engine assessment is instance-invalid with XSD.HintOrder. The verified seven-ID guard does not cover this case.
categories.nextAction: Assess exact source-pinned profile/guard extension and required authorization independently. No identical-hint exception follows from1.0 rule4; no automatic addition to the approved seven and no original pass credit.

QName calls Imported with a new visited set for foreign namespaces.
Imported recursively walks included/redefined Sources, leaking their import permissions into the caller.

importRepairScopeRecommendation.smallestCorrection: Authorize foreign-namespace QNames only against owner.Source.Imports, retaining a charged/polling lookup at the authored location. Do not recurse through Includes for permission. Keep global component lookup, legal mutual-import loading, chameleon effective target handling, and Contains recursion for redefine membership unchanged.

regressionDirections.check: Pin original elemZ007 and schZ005 complete resource graphs; prove principal references reject with XSD.SchemaRestriction and principal source provenance despite child import and globally loaded foreign component. Multi-hop/redefine inclusion is the same permission boundary.
Principal imports b and includes a child that references b without its own import; child must reject at child provenance. Adding the child import makes the same component graph legal.

Child imports b and references b locally while principal does not reference b; compile succeeds. Add a principal b reference plus its own import without schemaLocation; succeeds using the already loaded b components. Preserve mutual imports/chameleon identities and existing budget, cancellation and stream ownership checks.

importRepairScopeRecommendation.scopeBoundary: Only document-local QName import authorization and its independent proofs. Missing-component representation, cycle policy, unavailable-resource mappings, corpus classifiers and frozen public/model APIs are separate decisions.
